status: Declared under the operator's standing rules; the version decisions await sign-off.

divergences.stripe: Serves every selectable version, 2011-01-01 to 2026-08-26.dahlia, each in its own shape
divergences.app_emulator: Serves the dahlia release only (2026-03-25.dahlia to 2026-08-26.dahlia) in the 2026-08-26.dahlia shape; any other value, including .preview and endive, gets 400 invalid_request_error
divergences.reason: Monthly versions inside a release name are additive, so one shape serves the whole name faithfully; serving an older release the dahlia shape silently would be harder to diagnose than a 400

divergences.app_emulator: Accepts dahlia versions only; others get 400 parameter_invalid on api_version
divergences.reason: Events are rendered in the dahlia shape only; a label from another release would misdescribe the payload

divergences.stripe: Set by the account's first request, changed in Workbench
divergences.app_emulator: Configuration: STRIPE_API_VERSION, a dahlia version, default 2026-08-26.dahlia
divergences.reason: The emulated account exists before any request

divergences.stripe: The v2 namespace (event destinations, thin events, v2 accounts, meter event streams)
divergences.reason: Needs a second request encoding, page-token pagination and thin events; out of this target

divergences.stripe: Verifies the key exists on an account; an unknown key gets 401 Invalid API Key provided
divergences.app_emulator: Accepts any test-mode secret or restricted key (sk_test_, rk_test_); any other key gets the same 401
divergences.reason: The app emulator issues no keys

divergences.stripe: Refuses a field outside the resource's expandable fields
divergences.app_emulator: Enforces the documented four-level depth only; any field whose value is a known object ID is expanded, and an unknown field is ignored
divergences.reason: Field-level expansion rules are not modelled in this build

divergences.stripe: Saves a result only once the endpoint begins executing; a request that fails parameter validation is not saved
divergences.app_emulator: Saves the first response for a key whatever its status
divergences.reason: Validation and execution are not separated in the handlers

divergences.stripe: Retries failed deliveries with exponential backoff for up to three days
divergences.app_emulator: Up to three attempts, a few hundred milliseconds apart
divergences.reason: Local and CI runs need prompt, bounded delivery

divergences.stripe: Refuses files over Stripe's per-file size limit
divergences.app_emulator: Does not enforce the per-file limit
divergences.reason: Unchanged in this build; recorded so the gap is visible

divergences.app_emulator: Control plane for tests: health, reset, state, time, faults, and Stripe-specific triggers (fail a payout, fund an account, complete a Checkout Session, advance subscriptions, authenticate a PaymentIntent, create and resolve disputes)
divergences.reason: Lets tests drive outcomes that Stripe produces asynchronously or from the Dashboard
